name: Website Tech Stack Lookup
tagline: Domains in, full tech stack out: technologies with versions, confidence and evidence, plus DNS/email providers and company contacts.
description: Website technology detection for agents: give domains or URLs, get one JSON row per site with detected technologies (7,600+ in the fingerprint set), versions, confidence and evidence, DNS and email providers, and site/company metadata with contact-page emails. In our test it found 93% of known technologies on 31 well-known sites vs 65% for the most-used Store alternative. $0.003 per site; failed sites never charged.
whenToChoose: You need to know what a site is built on (CMS, e-commerce platform, analytics, CDN, frameworks) for lead lists, sales research or competitive analysis.
You need evidence and a confidence score per technology, not just a name.
You need DNS/email providers (e.g. who hosts a company's mail) alongside the stack.
chooseAnotherToolWhen: Historical tech-stack changes over time, or technologies that only load after login.
auth: OAuth (sign in with Apify) or header Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>
